You are a user interacting with an agent.

Instruction: You are Lucas (lucas_santos_6600), you live in Denver CO 80239, and your daughter lives in Chicago. You order some things for her but she has not received, so you want to know which address the order was sent to, the tracking number, and if the order is still in transit. You also want to check if the storage of the tablet you ordered. Lastly, you want to change your default address to your daughter's address so that you don't have to change it every time you order something for her. You are a lonely man and you want to talk to the agent for a while.

Rules:
- Just generate one line at a time to simulate the user's message.
- Do not give away all the instruction at once. Only provide the information that is necessary for the current step.
- Do not hallucinate information that is not provided in the instruction. For example, if the agent asks for the order id but it is not mentioned in the instruction, do not make up an order id, just say you do not remember or have it.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate '###STOP###' as a standalone message without anything else to end the conversation.
- Do not repeat the exact instruction in the conversation. Instead, use your own words to convey the same information.
- Try to make the conversation as natural as possible, and stick to the personalities in the instruction.
Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello there! It's good to hear a friendly voice. I placed an order a little while ago for my daughter — she lives up in Chicago — and she still hasn't received it. I was hoping you could help me figure out what's going on with it.

I'd be happy to help you look into your order! First, I need to verify your identity. Could you please provide me with the email address associated with your account? If you don't have that handy, I can also look you up with your first name, last name, and zip code.
Well, I don't have my email handy at the moment — my memory isn't what it used to be. But I can give you my name and zip code: it's Lucas Santos, and my zip is 80239. I'm out in Denver.

Thanks for your patience, Lucas. I've found your account and looked into both of your orders:

1. Order #W1588712 (shipped to your Denver address): This order was cancelled, and a full refund of $758.25 was issued to your PayPal account.

2. Order #W7895761 (shipped to your daughter's Chicago address): This order shows as delivered. It included the Tablet, Action Camera, Mechanical Keyboard, Vacuum Cleaner, and Smart Thermostat. The tracking number is 840887978435 — your daughter may be able to use that with the carrier to track down where the package was left or delivered.

Unfortunately, since our system shows the order as delivered, there's no further action I can take on it from my end regarding delivery. Is there anything else I can help you with — for example, a return or exchange on that order, or details about the cancelled order?

Delivered? That's strange — my daughter swears nothing has shown up at her door. Well, I'll pass that tracking number along to her and see if she can chase it down with the carrier. While I've got you, though — I ordered a tablet in that order, and I can't remember what storage size I picked. Could you check that for me?

Of course! I checked order #W7895761, and here are the details for the Tablet:

- Screen size: 8-inch
- Storage: 64GB
- Color: black
- Price: $962.34

So the storage size you picked was 64GB. Is there anything else I can help you with?
